state.title: Fasten a bracket bolt with a ratchet in confined access

comments: The robot picks up a ratchet from its cradle, fits the socket onto a started bracket bolt, and seats it using short drive and return strokes between two walls. Partial credit now measures axial advancement from the 2.5 mm initial gap; seating credit requires actual head/bracket contact, with a continuous 0.5-second hold for full credit. Torque and productive-cycle counts are diagnostics only. Thread-integrity, penetration and fixture checks remain enforced. The revised demo withdraws the socket and exposes the seated interface. Two seed-17 demos each finished at 1.0 in 3,150 actions; Dream-1 scored 0.0 at the 4,000-action limit. Both use the same frozen source, assets, physics and cameras. Media M-RPDV89 contains the matching current demo, Dream video and authentic setup screenshot, replacing the historical recordings. Validation: 42 offline scorer/contact/mechanism/asset checks passed, both live demos and resets passed, and recorded-trace audits reproduced the scores. The README documents physical gap measurement and exposed-interface inspection separately from numerical contact checks. No verified service torque or clamp preload is claimed. Runtime versions, source/asset hashes, video hashes and point-by-point responses are in the task folder.
